subject: No-train certification & onshore custody path for Horizon pilot
messages:
From: Alice Romero <alice@horizonhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Horizon Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: No-train certification & onshore custody path for Horizon pilot

Markus,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As we scope the pilot for Horizon Health, procurement needs written confirmation and evidence on a few privacy items before the legal DPA addendum is signed: 

1) A signed "No-Training" certification stating Redwood will not use Horizon production or pilot interaction data to train or improve any models (including fine-tuning) for the duration of the pilot.
2) A current subprocessor list and attestation that any subprocessors who will touch Horizon data are subject to the same no-training controls.
3) Confirmation that customer traffic from the pilot will be routed and stored within US regions only, with an option for on-prem KMS or Redwood-managed onshore KMS.
4) A simple ops diagram showing the custody path from ingestion to ephemeral storage/kv cache behavior and any export lanes (SFTP/API) for data egress.

Procurement would like these items by EOD Friday so we can slot the addendum into our vendor sign-off window. If there are parts that need legal redlines, flag them and we can follow up, but we need the operational assertions and attachments (e.g., certification PDF, routing diagram).

Best,
Alice
Alice Romero
Head of Data Partnerships
Horizon Health

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (referenced; procurement will upload to their system)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Attached are the operational artifacts you requested (see stubs below). Summary of what we're providing now and what follows: 

Attachments (attached to this message):
- horizon-no-train-certificate.pdf (signed operational no-training certification)
- ops-routing-diagram.png (high-level custody path and export lanes)

What these artifacts assert (short):
- No-Training: Redwood certifies that for Horizon's pilot (pilot start date written into the DPA addendum) we will not use customer content (inputs, outputs, metadata) to train or improve any production models, nor will we include it in any internal datasets used for model updates. This is enforced by a tenant-level "no-learning" configuration enforced at inference routing.
- Subprocessors: we attach an attestation excerpt in the certificate; full subprocessor inventory is here: https://redwood.company/drive/horizon/no-train-evidence (link). All subprocessors listed are contractually bound to the same no-train restriction for Horizon.
- Onshore custody & KMS: ops-routing-diagram.png shows ingestion -> regional routing (US-west) -> ephemeral KV cache settings (writes retained < 5 minutes unless explicitly exported) -> optional SFTP export lane (onshore SFTP) or API export. KMS options: a) customer-managed on-prem KMS via our connector (instructions in the certificate), or b) Redwood-managed onshore KMS with key residency in US regions.

Next steps (for procurement/legal):
- Please confirm whether you require DocuSign for the No-Train Certification or if a scan of the signed PDF is sufficient.
- If DPA addendum redlines are needed, send them to legal@horizonhealth.com and cc me; we will route to our legal team.
- If you want a technical walkthrough of the routing diagram and the runtime toggle enforcement, David can drop into a short call tomorrow morning.

We're aiming to have the formal addendum link ready (DocuSign) by EOD today if procurement confirms.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Trust & Technical Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: horizon-no-train-certificate.pdf, ops-routing-diagram.png

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-06-20T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: No-train certification & onshore custody path for Horizon pilot

Hi Alice — quick ops confirmation to accompany Marissa's package.

Key operational guarantees (summary):
- Tenant-level no-learning toggle: enabled for Horizon's tenant. This switch prevents any interaction content from being appended to training datasets or any asynchronous model fine-tuning queues. Enforcement is at the routing layer; we log attempts and emit an alert on any anomalous pipeline touching learning subsystems.
- KV cache and ephemeral state: default retention for pilot is set to ephemeral (max 300 seconds). We will disable long-term KV persistence and disable suffix-based caching for this tenant during the pilot unless you explicitly request otherwise.
- Onshore routing: all traffic for this pilot will be served from our US-west region (multi-AZ inside the region). Exports (SFTP/API) will be configured to use an onshore export endpoint. We can provide a signed ops attestation for routing.
- KMS options: we support (1) customer-managed on-prem HSM integration (we provide connector docs) or (2) Redwood-managed KMS with key material stored in US-only HSMs. Customer-managed keys require a short onboarding window to establish the connector and test encryption/decryption flows.

If Horizon procurement confirms DocuSign, I'll include the final ops attestation as part of the envelope. Otherwise, let me know and we'll provide a signed PDF.
